method: Authorized static analysis and read-only saved-data checks only. No device access, original firmware execution, or deployment.

findings.interpretation: Disk prefix is 30 bytes, not an aligned memory grid object. Writer emits 10-byte RRSLAM/version2/header-length20 prefix then 20-byte scale20,left,top,width,height block. Dispatcher checks both magic fragments, uint16 version and header length. V2 body checks scale20. All multibyte disk fields are little endian; origins are signed int32, dimensions raw uint32.
limits: GridDiskHeaderV2 uses only byte arrays: exact offsets and alignment1, no forced packing pragma or aligned uint32 overlay.
Unknown magic goes to older-format helper0x1ca54; version1/header36 goes to0x1cf60; legacy decoding is intentionally outside bounded recovery.

findings.interpretation: Cell block is width*height bytes in row-major order, followed by 16-byte MD5-compatible digest over cell block only. Every digest word must match before v2 modifies target. Writer extracts metadata.view relative to metadata.bounds. Reader clears full existing cells to0x80, re-centers bounds, installs/merges file view, then copies rows using full bounds stride.
limits: No explicit reader dimensions/overflow/allocation-bounds validation or trailing-file-length validation was found in these paths.
Positive width copy guard is signed; row loop uses unsigned height. Width*height is low32-bit MUL. Do not claim malformed files are safe.

Digest routine IV bytes at VA0x3f434:0123456789abcdeffedcba9876543210. NULL cells produces zero digest; high bit-length word forced0, so ordinary-grid MD5 equivalence must not be extended to huge inputs.

findings.interpretation: Static path inference: an intact but unsupported-scale/version/header-length or wrong-digest file can leave stream state good while cells are not accepted. Cache loader can then retain initialized0x80 buffer with valid1, and future cache hits bypass disk. A nonzero file-loader return alone does not prove format acceptance.
limits: This is static control-flow reasoning, not a firmware runtime test.
Intermediate stream checks mask bit1 only; outer file wrappers mask5. Short-read handling depends on C++ stream state and is not asserted safe.

findings.interpretation: String-slot accessor is store+4*(flag+18), not a C-string pointer. Flag0 mobility_test_map;1 last_map;2..11 user_map(flag-2);12 /dev/shm/tmp_map. Constructor also creates a separate first12 vmap path family. No flag validation in accessor. Saved cell cache index flag+11 is distinct from filename slot index flag+18.
limits: Literal addresses and decoded nonprivate path strings recorded separately below; .rodata uses loader VA=file offset here, verified against inventory, not assumed globally.

findings.interpretation: Saved-buffer lookup indexes flag+11. Populated cell pointer returns immediately without disk read. Miss allocates1024x1024 cells, centered bounds, fill0x80, selects filename string, reads via dispatcher. Allocation/open/outer stream failure drops cache slot and sets result valid0. Drop clears pointer before delete[], zeroes36-byte metadata. Bulk drop loops flags1..11 inclusive, excluding0 and12.
limits: No file unlink/rename in drop functions; caches and files are separate.
No locks inside lookup/allocation/drop functions were observed. Outer caller synchronization is unresolved; string reference-count atomics do not lock grid caches.

findings.interpretation: One existing boundary function calls bulk cache-drop before selected saved-buffer read at0x175b8/0x175cc and after copying at0x17646. A separate reset branch drops at0x172f2. This establishes a fresh-cache branch, not universal reload behavior.
limits: Boundary owner state/branch semantics and transform calculations remain unknown; no algorithm expansion performed.
Boundary0x1718c retains FUN_0001718c and unknown signature; only comment was added. Decompiled owner-relative imported-symbol string aliases are artifacts, not claimed object layouts.

findings.interpretation: Runtime-save wrapper always obtains manager slot11 and writes to caller-supplied string filename in output mode0x10. Return bool is captured from state&5 before filebuf.close; close return ignored. Read-file wrapper behaves similarly in input mode8. No rename/fsync or saved-cache invalidation in save wrapper. These return values are not map-set transaction or durability acknowledgments.
limits: GridSaveRuntime first argument remains explicitly unknown/unused. It does not choose a flag; caller0x92e0 owns broader selection/order and is outside this bounded recovery.
No robot runtime or power-failure behavior tested.

findings.interpretation: Corrected surviving stream read/write prototypes to explicit this(r0), buffer(r1), count(r2), preserving names. Grid* types model only storage-observed ABI: rectangle16, metadata36 with last4 unknown, ref12 with padding/unknown3, read-context8. These are effective storage views, not original C++ layout recovery.
limits: In-memory rectangle fields are signed to express actual geometry/copy comparisons; file dimensions are raw unsigned LE words. Original source declarations are not claimed.

disk_layout.digest_offset: 30 + low32(width*height) in firmware; codec validates mathematical product and exact size

corrections_to_earlier_prose: ASSESSMENT correctly reports ordinary packed v2 offsets. Its version2 reader anchor alone does not contain magic/version/header-length checks: those belong to dispatcher0x1d42c.
Exact-size/nonzero-dimension checks in map_codec.py are stricter than the native reader; do not attribute them to firmware.
MD5 match covers cells only and does not validate origin, dimensions, scale or file authenticity. Four words are checked before copying, but mismatch is not explicitly translated into stream failure.
A native load can return a cached grid; one branch0x1718c explicitly drops caches around a read. Neither observation proves universal fresh-file loading.
Grid save bool checks stream state before close, with no close-result/durability validation. This is separate from asynchronous persistence rename logic.
Zero-cell-product path yields zero digest via NULL buffer rather than MD5(empty); ordinary saved grids are nonzero.

open_questions.question: Exact occupancy-byte probability mapping, including intermediate values;0/128/255 meanings are not asserted by this recovery.
All outer synchronization and concurrency guarantees around cache read/drop; storage-local code has no cache mutex.
Which higher-level startup/load branches always drop caches, including flag12 handling and process restart behavior? Only bounded branch verified.
Source meaning of metadata+32..35, ref+9..11, and boundary owner state/branch flags.
Legacy format readers0x1ca54/0x1cf60 and short-read exception behavior; not expanded.
Higher-level grid/persistence/catalog acknowledgment ordering and durability; owned by orchestration/integration.

validation.reopen_comparison: 27 C files byte-identical; selected.json and types.json structurally identical (types.json object-key order differs). Separate no-annotations headless run on closed/reopened final project.
validation.final_apply: Final annotation document applied successfully to fresh baseline copy ghidra-project-final, with exact pristine preconditions.
validation.limitations: Synthetic/codec/data/export tests are not firmware execution and do not establish runtime safety.
